the functionalization of amino and Fe(3+) complex mesoporous SBA-15 adsorbents with different content of amino and iron groups (named N, N-SBA15 and N, N-Fe-SBA15) can be successfully prepared.
the functionalized groups on mesoporous silica could be used as an efficient adsorbent for TC removal from aqueous solutions.
amino and Fe3+-amine complex mesoporous silicas are effective adsorbents for the removal of tetracyclines.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the preparation and characterization of amino and amino complex mesoporous adsorbents and the effect of the functionalized groups on TC adsorption.
the preparation of amino and amino complex mesoporous SBA-15 adsorbents, and their application in the removal of TC from aqueous solutions.
the preparation of amino and amino complex mesoporous adsorbents for the removal of TC.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the amino and Fe3+-functionalized mesoporous silicas are efficient and promising adsorbents for the adsorption of antibiotics.

the functionalized groups of amino and Fe-amine complex onto mesoporous silica can significantly improve the adsorption capacity of tetracyclines, and the adsorption of amino and Fe-N,N- complex adsorbents is mainly related to the outer-sphere and inner-sphere surface complexation, respectively.
the functionalized groups of amino and Fe complex onto SBA15 have a significant impact on the adsorption capacity for tetracycline.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the adsorption of organic pollutants on amino-Fe3+-functionalized adsorbents could be controlled by the coordination of functional groups with the organic pollutants.
the adsorption of organic compounds onto amino and amino complex functionalized mesoporous materials is related to the formation and the coordination of functional groups.

the adsorption of organic pollutants onto the amino complex adsorbent was related to the formation outer-sphere surface complex and the adsorption onto the Fe3+-amine complex adsorbent mainly attributed to the formation of inner-sphere surface complex.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the amino-Fe3+-complex mesoporous silica could be a promising candidate for the removal of tetracyclines from aqueous solution.
Fe3+ can enhance the adsorption of amino mesoporous silica for TC removal.
amino and Fe3+-amine mesoporous silica materials are excellent adsorbents for the adsorption of antibiotics in aqueous solution.
